lastCompletedStory.title: Story detail subview on Enter, back on Esc, with contextual keybar

nextStoryContext: US-006 added story detail subview and contextual keybar to Dashboard.tsx: (1) renamed selectionReducer to take SelectionState {selected: number, mode: 'list'|'detail'} instead of bare number; added 'enter' and 'esc' actions; (2) DashboardApp state is now sel: SelectionState = {selected:0, mode:'list'}; (3) useInput handles key.return (Enter opens detail), key.escape (Esc returns to list); nav/dispatch keys are guarded by `if (sel.mode === 'detail') return`; (4) render is conditional: list mode renders StoriesSection+RecentSection+Keybar; detail mode renders StoryDetailView+DetailKeybar; (5) StoryDetailView shows: icon+id+title row, acceptanceCriteria checklist with square checkbox (U+25A1), Notes: block when non-empty, Review: row when reviewLastVerdict is set; (6) DetailKeybar shows only 'Esc back to list' + 'q close pane'; (7) orderedForDetail sorted inside DashboardApp for detail view lookup (same sort as StoriesSection uses). Key gotcha: lone ESC byte triggers Ink's pending-escape 20ms buffer (createInputParser), so tests using stdin.write('\x1b') need `await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, 50))` not the 0ms tick(). US-005 reducer tests updated from selectionReducer(0,'down',5) to selectionReducer({selected:0,mode:'list'},'down',5). 815 tests pass.

officialDocsValidated.summary: Ink docs confirm: key.escape (boolean, Escape key pressed) and key.return (boolean, Return/Enter key pressed) exist in the Key object returned to useInput callbacks. Implementation using `if (key.escape)` and `if (key.return)` matches the documented API.
